title: The Horned Rider
text: A rider with antlers growing up through his helm leads a herd of elk across the plain, a thousand of them moving like one beast. He reins in before you. His eyes are an animal's eyes. He asks for the one among you who has killed the most beasts.

options.label: The most blooded steps forward to be judged, and does not flinch.

outcomes.text: He judges them fairly, and gives them a horn to call the herd.
He judges them harshly, and the herd turns as one.

options.label: The gentlest speaks for you instead, hoping mercy weighs more than blood.

outcomes.text: He is satisfied, and the herd parts to let you pass.

options.label: Hide in the brush until he passes, and hope the herd does not find you.

outcomes.text: The herd passes, a thousand elk, and tramples your packs.
